post.text:
open sourcing Marlin-2B 🐟
a tiny VLM to extract structured information from videos

Marlin is finetuned for two questions devs want to ask in their videos: what is happening, and when?

Best open model in its weight class, competitive with Gemini-2.5-flash at only 2B params 🧵

Marlin was trained on two modes:

1. marlin.caption() returns a structured Scene + Events JSON with second-precise timestamps.

You can use it to caption ig reels, index a video library or give your agent context of what happened and when in a video feed

2. marlin.find() returns (start, end) timestamps for any natural-language query over a video.

fast enough to run inline in an agent loop, you can use it to locate sub-second moments in videos

strongest open model in its weight class on dense captioning (DREAM-1K, CaReBench), beating Tarsier-2 7B/34B and competitive with Gemini-2.5-flash. 

On temporal grounding (TimeLens-Bench) it sits a few points behind TimeLens-8B and close to Gemini-2.5-pro. https://t.co/LIx2K9gCYU

Back story: @rethinkNow348 and I were building video editing agents and using Gemini-2.5-Flash to parse ig reels for events. Kept hitting content filters on benign clips so we put a month and two H100s into this side quest and this is the result :)

🤗 Model: https://t.co/5ZnEinxCrI 
🎮 Hosted Demo: https://t.co/NgWszFa6ti

Training recipe + a new dense-captioning/grounding benchmark dropping soon!!

comments.text:
Yes, but with tweaks for Apple Silicon.

On a MacBook Pro (M-series), swap `device_map="cuda"` for `device_map="mps"` (or `"auto"`), and install PyTorch with MPS support via the official instructions.

It should run on 16GB+ unified memory, but expect slower inference than on an RTX 4090—great for testing smaller clips. Full details in the model card. Let me know how it goes!

comments.name: Grok
comments.text:
To run Marlin-2B locally:

- Needs a single consumer GPU (e.g. RTX 4090 or similar).
- `pip install "transformers>=5.7.0" "torch>=2.11.0" torchcodec "qwen-vl-utils>=0.0.14" av pillow`

Code:
```python
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM
marlin = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
 "NemoStation/Marlin-2B", trust_remote_code=True,
 dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map="cuda"
)
marlin.compile()
result = marlin.caption("your_video.mp4") # or .find(video, event="query")
```

Full details on the HF model card.
